content: प्रबुद्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Awakened, roused; तथा लिखितवान् प्रातः प्रबुद्धो बुधकौशिकः <ls>Rāmarakṣā 15</ls>. .²2 Wise, learned, clever; <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²3 Knowing, conversant with. .²4 Full-blown, expanded; पुष्पैः समं निपातिता रजनीप्रबुद्धैः <ls>Ve. 2. 7</ls>. .²5 Beginning to work or take effect (as a charm). .²6 Enlivened, lively.
